products.title: LED Light Bars for Canopy Tents
products.description:
LED Light Bars for Canopy Tents

Brighten up your booth and stand out at any event with our LED Light Bars for Canopy Tents — the perfect lighting solution for food vendors, trade shows, night markets, and outdoor festivals. Designed to deliver powerful illumination while remaining lightweight and easy to install, these LED bars ensure your products and branding stay visible, day or night.

💡 Ultra-Bright Illumination: High-output LED bars provide even, consistent lighting across your entire canopy.
🔆 3 Light Modes: Switch between Daylight, Warm, and Amber settings to match the mood, event style, or time of day.
🔋 Energy-Efficient LEDs: Long-lasting, low-power-consumption lights designed for all-day use.
⚙️ Easy Installation: Mounts securely to canopy tent frames—no tools required.
🎪 Universal Fit: Compatible with most 10x10, 10x15, and 10x20 canopy tent structures.
🔌 Multiple Power Options: Includes AC adapter for standard outlets; battery-pack compatible (optional).
🎒 Portable & Lightweight: Designed for quick setup, takedown, and transport.
🌙 Perfect for Night Events: Ideal for food booths, vendor displays, art shows, and evening festivals.
🛠️ Durable Build: Shock-resistant housing suitable for repeated outdoor use.

What’s Included:

- (4) Light Bars

- Carrying Bag

- Outlet Power Cable

- USB Power Cable

- Battery Power Cable

- 12V auxiliary Power Cable

- Extension Cables

- Switch Cable

- 2-Way Connector

- 4-Way Connector

- Canopy Clips

- Screw Mount Clips

- Cable Ties (Hook-and-loop)

- Zip Ties

Additional Notes:

- 8 light bars is the max limit to connect

- If used with a metal frame, lights can attach with the magnet that is on the back of them.

- Lights have 3 tones: Daylight, Warm Light, and Amber (bug repelling)

- 6 watts per light, 680 lumens, Voltage：12v, 0.5 amps. ETL Certified

Primary Usage:

Food booths, vendor tents, farmers’ markets, night events, trade shows, craft fairs, outdoor festivals.
